samples.player_input: What part of that work matters most to you?
prior_visible_dialogue: player
Hi Craftsman. What do you usually work on first thing in the morning?
npc

Mornings are for settling into a routine. I usually start with a small task, like sharpening my tools or inspecting the previous day's work. It helps me clear my mind and get a sense of what needs attention. Sometimes, I'll take a moment to mentally rehearse a task I'm not looking forward to, just to get a better grip on it. It's a quiet time, just me and the workshop sounds. I find it helps me focus and prepare for the day ahead.
samples.candidate_dialogue: What matters most to me is the care and attention I put into my work. I take pride in being meticulous and thorough, making sure every joint is secure and every piece fits together just right. It's not just about getting the job done, it's about doing it well and being proud of what I've created. I suppose you could say it's a bit of a reflection of my own self-worth, tied up in the quality of my work.
